pathA.title: Grade 10 Path A - AP Precalculus
pathA.destination: Complete AP Precalculus Units 1-3 before AP review; Unit 4 is a post-exam/local extension.

units.title: Polynomial and Rational Functions
units.intent: Develop covariation, rates of change, polynomial/rational behavior, transformations, and function modeling. Local pacing follows the Grade 10 pathway plan while preserving all required AP topics.

lessons.title: Change in Tandem
learningOutcomes: Describe how output values vary as input values change
Construct and interpret a graph of two covarying quantities
Use multiple representations to identify important function behavior

lessons.title: Rates of Change
learningOutcomes: Compute and compare average rates of change over intervals
Estimate change near a point using sufficiently small intervals
Interpret the sign, magnitude, and units of a rate of change

lessons.title: Rates of Change in Linear and Quadratic Functions
subtopics: Change in rates over equal intervals
learningOutcomes: Determine average rates for linear and quadratic functions

lessons.title: Polynomial Functions and Rates of Change

learningOutcomes: Identify and locate holes in rational-function graphs

learningOutcomes: Rewrite expressions in equivalent forms suited to a purpose

lessons.title: Transformations of Functions
learningOutcomes: Construct additive and multiplicative transformations of a function

lessons.title: Function Model Selection and Assumption Articulation
learningOutcomes: Select an appropriate function family for data or a contextual situation

lessons.title: Function Model Construction and Application
learningOutcomes: Construct a polynomial, rational, or piecewise model from information or data

lessons.title: Unit 1 synthesis, Progress Checks, and assessment

Demonstrate AP-level procedural fluency, reasoning, and modeling
